requirements.text: An online booking system to simplify appointment scheduling for customers.
Automated reminders for customers—one day and one hour before their appointments.
A way to manage and track bookings, cancellations, and no-shows.
A straightforward booking experience for customers that includes service selection and barber choice.
The ability for customers to cancel or change appointments without calling.
The system should be easy to learn and use for both customers and staff, fitting within the existing workflow.
